detail.command:
set -e
npm install
npm run typecheck
npm run build
printf '\n=== PUBLISHED COURSE COUNTS ===\n'
for spec in 'neon-city.ts neon' 'haunted-mansion.ts haunted' 'space-station.ts space'; do set -- $spec; n=$(grep -o "id:'$2-[0-9][0-9]'" "src/courses/data/$1" | wc -l | tr -d ' '); printf '%s: %s\n' "$1" "$n"; test "$n" = 9; done
ids=$(grep -ho "id:'\(neon\|haunted\|space\)-[0-9][0-9]'" src/courses/data/*.ts | sort); test "$(printf '%s\n' "$ids" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = 27; test "$(printf '%s\n' "$ids" | uniq | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = 27
printf 'unique hole ids: 27\n'
printf '\n=== STATUS ===\n'; git status --short
